matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies that the encryption using random orthogonal matrices P_k breaks the logic of leverage score computation and sample selection, which directly corresponds to GT1's claim that the incorrectly ordered/defined orthogonal matrices break the feature aggregation logic and invalidate downstream leverage score computations.

GT2 concerns the ill-formed definition of leverage scores in Eq. (5) involving e_{i,j}^T × U_k. Finding 3 discusses normalization and probability distribution issues around Eq. (6), which is a different equation addressing a different aspect of the sampling procedure. No finding addresses the specific matrix-vector dimension mismatch in Eq. (5).

Finding 2 identifies the contradiction between Eq. (7) and Eq. (9) regarding temperature scaling and softmax application (separate vs. concatenated logits), which directly matches GT3's description of inconsistent temperature scaling definitions and unclear concatenations between these equations.
